content_sections.heading: THSTI Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About THSTI
content_sections.text: THSTI is located at the NCR Biotech Science Cluster on the Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway in Faridabad. This vacancy is on its project "A Multicentric Evaluation of Indian Population-Specific Tools for Antenatal Estimation of Gestational Age", with Dr. Nitya Wadhwa as Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Staff Nurse Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies may change according to the actual requirement at the time of the written test, skill test or interview. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: THSTI Staff Nurse Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is 35 years. The date of interview is the crucial date for deciding eligibility on age, experience and essential qualification. B.Sc. (Nursing) from a recognised University, OR GNM from a recognised University with at least one (1) year of experience in a relevant field. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognised Board or University. The candidate must have experience in clinical training in antenatal care, with skills relevant to maternal health. The required experience must have been gained after obtaining the minimum educational qualification for the post. Experience in clinical research in the maternal and child health domain Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines Experience in performing anthropometry and blood pressure monitoring for pregnant women Knowledge of electronic data collection tools Proficiency in Excel and basic computer skills Good communication skills in Hindi and English Candidates must satisfy themselves that they meet the criteria before appearing, as no query on eligibility will be entertained. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

rows.relaxation: Up to 5 years, in accordance with Central Government instructions or orders issued from time to time
To the extent of service rendered by them as on the closing date of the advertisement
Up to the extent of service in the defence forces (Army, Navy and Air Force) plus 3 years, provided they have at least 6 months of attested service

content_sections.heading: Staff Nurse Job Description
content_sections.text: The nurse will assist research officers with clinical tasks and data collection, and will be responsible for participant screening, enrolment, follow-up and data collection. Participant screening and enrolment: screening and enrolling participants in the study as per the protocol Data collection: assisting in collecting clinical data such as blood pressure monitoring and anthropometric measurements Ultrasound monitoring: scheduling and supervising ultrasound scans for pregnant women Field activities reporting: daily reporting of field activities and clinical data Case Report Forms (CRFs): filing and maintaining CRFs Communication: ensuring smooth communication with participants and research staff

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be through a written test, skill test or interview at the walk-in. If a large number of applications is received, screening will limit the number of candidates to those with higher or relevant qualification and experience.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is a short-term position. Extension will be granted subject to satisfactory performance and the tenure of the project. Those appointed will not have any claim for regularisation of their employment. For any matter not covered in the notification, the bye laws of THSTI and Government of India rules and guidelines shall prevail.

faq.question: Q1. Can a GNM nurse attend the THSTI Staff Nurse walk-in?
faq.answer: Yes. A GNM from a recognised University is accepted with at least one year of experience in a relevant field, along with experience in clinical training in antenatal care.

faq.question: Q2. Is antenatal care experience compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says the candidate must have experience in clinical training in antenatal care, with skills relevant to maternal health.

faq.question: Q3. On which date is age calculated?
faq.answer: Age, experience and essential qualification are all judged as on the date of interview, which is the crucial date under the notice.

faq.question: Q4. How much age relaxation do OBC and SC/ST candidates get?
faq.answer: OBC candidates get 3 years and SC/ST candidates get 5 years. PwBD candidates get 10 years (UR), 13 years (OBC) or 15 years (SC/ST).

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a short-term project position, and those appointed have no claim for regularisation of their employment.

faq.question: Q6. What happens if I reach the venue late?
faq.answer: Candidates coming after the mentioned time slot will not be entertained, so be at the venue by 9:00 am.

faq.question: Q7. Can I keep my mobile phone during the selection process?
faq.answer: No. Every candidate must deposit the phone and a valid identity proof at the reception, and both are returned only after the selection process ends.

faq.question: Q8. How will THSTI share results and updates?
faq.answer: All results and notifications will be published only on the THSTI website, and all communications will be made only through email.
